authority: Chapter 7: bundlers read .vibe, not declaration sidecars
source:
export const entries = await Array.fromAsync(new Bun.Glob("**/*.ts").scan({ cwd: "src" })).then(files => files.filter(file => !file.endsWith(".d.ts")))
export async function build() { return Bun.build({ entrypoints: entries.map(file => "src/" + file), outdir: "dist" }) }
